skill.name: ai-avatar-video
skill.description: Generate AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos with RunComfy. The skill chooses a matching model for portraits, scripts, audio, and reference media, then prepares the RunComfy CLI call.
skill.summary: Create AI avatar and lip-sync videos through the RunComfy CLI.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Markdown RunComfy workflow guide with no executable source file beyond documented CLI usage. All static findings were adjudicated as false positives: Markdown backticks, expected RunComfy links, documented token storage, and model-routing wording misread as reconnaissance. No prompt injection attempt was found.

content.user_title: Create AI Avatar and Lip-Sync Videos
content.value_statement: Creating avatar videos often requires choosing between several model workflows. This skill routes each request to the best RunComfy model and prepares the CLI command.
actual_capabilities: Selects OmniHuman for portrait and audio avatar videos.
Selects Wan 2-7 when scene prompts need audio-driven lip sync.
Selects HappyHorse when the user has a script but no audio file.
Selects Seedance v2 Pro for cinematic shots with reference media.
Provides RunComfy CLI commands with model IDs and output directory guidance.
limitations: Requires RunComfy CLI access and authentication before generation.
Most routes require user-provided media URLs for images or audio.
Output quality depends on source image framing and audio clarity.
Must not be used to imitate real people without consent.

use_cases.title: Create Product Presenter Clips
use_cases.description: Turn an approved portrait and voiceover into a short presenter video for ads, demos, or landing pages.

use_cases.title: Localize Existing Campaigns
use_cases.description: Reuse one presenter image with different approved voice tracks for multilingual video variants.

use_cases.title: Animate Stylized Characters
use_cases.description: Generate speaking clips for illustrated characters, mascots, or concept assets with synchronized audio.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Talking Head
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-avatar-video to create a short talking-head clip from this portrait URL and voiceover URL. Choose the simplest RunComfy route and explain the required inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Video From a Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-avatar-video to make a vertical presenter clip from this script. Choose a route that can generate speech in the same pass.

prompt_templates.title: Lip Sync a Styled Character
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-avatar-video to animate this illustrated character with the supplied audio URL. Pick the route best suited for non-photoreal subjects.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cinematic Avatar Shot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced campaign shot with reference media.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ai-avatar-video to plan a cinematic monologue using a subject reference image, voice reference, aspect ratio, duration, and lighting direction.

output_examples.input: A marketer provides a portrait URL and a clean voiceover URL for a product demo.
output_examples.output: The skill selects OmniHuman, lists the required image and audio inputs, and prepares a RunComfy command for the output folder.

output_examples.input: A producer has a written script but no recorded voice track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects HappyHorse, places the spoken line in the prompt, and recommends a short clip duration.

output_examples.input: A creative team wants a cinematic spokesperson clip with a subject image and reference audio.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Seedance v2 Pro and describes how to combine reference media with lens, lighting, and motion direction.

best_practices: Use clean voice audio without background music for stronger lip sync.
Use portraits or character images that you own or have permission to animate.
Keep spoken scripts short and generate longer stories as multiple clips.
anti_patterns: Do not create avatar videos of real people without consent.
Do not use low-quality audio and expect reliable mouth movement.
Do not choose cinematic routes for simple portrait and voiceover jobs.

faq.question: Does this skill generate the final video locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the RunComfy CLI to call hosted RunComfy model endpoints.

faq.question: Which model is the default route?
faq.answer: OmniHuman is the default for a portrait image paired with an audio file.

faq.question: Can it work without a recorded audio file?
faq.answer: Yes. HappyHorse can generate speech during the video generation pass from a written script.

faq.question: Can it animate illustrated characters?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill routes stylized characters to Wan 2-2 Animate when audio is available.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: The skill needs RunComfy CLI access and a valid RunComfy login or token.

faq.question: Can I use it for a public figure?
faq.answer: Only with clear rights and consent. The skill instructs refusal for unauthorized real-person impersonation.
